# Daily Report — 2026-10-24

## Task Completed
Add `list_import_set_rows` and `get_import_set_row` tools.  Each import set
writes its raw source data into a staging table (the `table_name` field on
`sys_import_set`).  The new tools surface those individual staging rows so
callers can inspect per-row transform state (`inserted`/`updated`/`ignored`/
`error`) and any error messages without having to know the staging table name
in advance.

New additions:
- `_get_staging_table` — resolves the staging table name from an import set id
- `_format_import_set_row` — normalises a staging row record
- `list_import_set_rows` — lists rows with `state`/`error_message` filters and
  `has_more`/`next_offset` pagination; returns `staging_table` in the response
- `get_import_set_row` — retrieves a single row by `import_set_id` + `row_sys_id`

Both tools registered in `system_administrator` and `full` packages.
